sentences.text:
Code vs In Re : Samidra Chowdhury @ Sudama ... on 20
February, 2023
Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 20.02.2023

KAUSHIK REJECTED C.R.M.(A) 756 of 2023 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Itahar Police Station Case No. 740 of 2021 dated 26.11.2021 under Sections 498A/302/304B/120b/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Itahar Police Station Case No. 740 of 2021
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
And In Re : Samidra Chowdhury @ Sudama Chowdhury & Anr.
...... petitioners Mr. Parvej Anam ....for the petitioners Mr. S. G.Mukherjee, learned Public Prosecutor Mr. Aniket Mitra ....for the State The police case is dated November 26, 2021.
There are materials in the case diary implicating the petitioners.

Considering the long absconsion of the petitioners in respect of the police case, the materials in the case diary, the gravity of the offence and the involvement of the petitioners in the incident, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Accordingly, prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is rejected and the application being CRM (A) 756 of 2023 is dismissed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
